thread:
opsbot: INCIDENT ALERT: abnormal KV cache growth detected on prod-serving cluster eu-west-1. rolling 5m spike in mem usage + 502 rates. auto-pager -> #incidents.

mike_sre: I'm on it. seeing continuous-batching window ballooning and prefix cache churn. dump incoming. tagging @sam_infra for infra traces.

elaine_prod: Customer dashboards (acme-marketing) show elevated latency and token retries. CS pinged. @raj_custsuccess FYI.

sam_infra: grabbed traces. hot path shows many very short requests getting deduped into a large fused batch due to new batching heuristics rolled 03:12. batch size distribution flattened -> catastrophic KV lookups. probable feedback loop: long batching = more KV keys => cache eviction pressure => misses => slower responses -> more batching.

mike_sre: Confirmed. reproducer on staging with traffic replay. root cause looks like combined change: batching window increased (+50ms tail) and prefix hashing tweak that changed tokenizer boundary behavior for several templates. mismatch increased unique prefix keys by ~8x.

elaine_prod: Impact: about 4 customer-facing endpoints degraded, latency P95 from 120ms -> 1.6s, 502s spiked for short gen calls. Billing unaffected but UX critical.

raj_custsuccess: I messaged the primary contact at Acme. They see timeouts in their job queue. Asked for ETA and mitigations.

mike_sre: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) roll back batching window change to previous value 2) disable prefix-hash tokenizer tweak on-hosts in eu-west-1 3) enable stricter KV TTL eviction policy for the hot shard. Doing steps 1+2 first to avoid churn.

ivy_pm: Prioritize rollback. We need a blameless RCA later but quick restore > analysis. Keep product and CS posted.

sam_infra: Rolling back batching config to stable commit in 30s via deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: deploy started: revert batch-window-change -> serverset prod/eu-west-1 (commit ad3f4b2)

mike_sre: After revert: early signs of stabilization. KV miss rate dropping, batch size median returning to ~8.

opsbot: SYSTEM: metric alert resolved: kv_mem_growth_eu-west-1 below threshold.

elaine_prod: P95 latency trending down, customers showing improvement. Raj, confirm with Acme?

raj_custsuccess: Acme confirms degraded endpoints are back to normal. They appreciate the quick fix. Logged follow-up ticket with customer notes.

mike_sre: Next step: follow-up patch to tokenizer tweak to preserve previous token boundaries for templated prefixes. Also schedule change to guard increased unique-prefix amplification in staging (unit test + load test).

sam_infra: Will add a canary check to the rollout pipeline: simulate templated prompt load and assert prefix-key cardinality delta < 1.5x.

ivy_pm: Add this regression test to Optimize backlog. Assign to @elaine_prod and @sam_infra for immediate triage.

mike_sre: Post-incident action items (short):
- revert confirmed (done)
- create regression test for prefix-hash/tokenizer interaction
- add circuit-breaker in batching runtime to cap fused batch size (soft limit + alert)
- add telemetry: unique prefix key delta per rollout, per-region

elaine_prod: Filing the incident page now. I'll include timelines and customer impact. Tagging SRE for RCA.

mike_sre: Final note: root cause = unintended combinatorial effect of two independent changes (batch-window increase + tokenizer boundary change) that individually seemed fine but together amplified keyspace. will capture in RCA and recommend a staged rollout safety net.

deploy-bot: deployment revert completed: 6 hosts rolled, no failures.

opsbot: HANDOFF: incident moved to postmortem tracking. Paging cleared. If anything else fires, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
